newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up after 3rd mth breaks 1,280 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up after 3rd mth breaks 1,280 rgt.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES -Shortcovering, speculative and technical buying pushed prices to a higher close after July futures broke 1,280 rgt. Prices were aided by firmness of cash, bullish palm forum and expectations of higher exports. Trading was fairly volatile. July's next resistance is 1,300.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market was firm as refiners covered positions.
"Chartwise, the contract is likely to test 1,300 ringgit after its breakout of the 1,260 and 1,280 range which we have been stuck with for weeks," a chartist said.
"Sentiment looks bullish with people buying due to the firmness in the cash market and expectation of good exports for April," another trader said.
Two cargo surveyors, Caleb Brett and SGS (M) Sdn Bhd are expected to release the full export data on Wednesday.
Another helping factor was the bullish outlook given at the Kuala Lumpur Commodity Exchange's 1997/1998 palm and laurics oils conference held on Saturday, traders said.
The trader added: "People were seen bullish about the forum. They were buying more for nearby contracts as they expect prices to move higher in the short-term due to favourable fundamental outlook."
The futures market posted double digit gains. Trading on was 1,972 lots.
Physicals May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,370 vs bids of 1,365 after trading from 1,360 to 1,365.
May (central) saw offers at 1,340 vs bids 1,335 with earlier trades done at 1,330 and 1,335.
June (south) was offered at 1,355 vs bids at 1,345 with earlier trades done at 1,335 and 1,345. June (central) saw offers at 1,320 versus bids at 1,310.
Among refined products, last-half May RBD palm oil was offered at $575, June at $567.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $550.

Last-half May RBD palm olein saw offers at $607.50, June at $600, and July/Aug/Sept at $582.50. May was traded at $605 and June at $590, $592 and $595. May RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
